notes.title: Survival Nation Lost Horizon - Steam Deck Verified 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

We are pleased to inform you that Survival Nation: Lost Horizon is [b]officially Steam Deck Verified[/b].   ✅ 🎉 
Grab your decks and try it out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/8965e63380a3bca813d72bb535ed82cd2ce41fba.png[/img]

Feel free to share your thoughts and feedback! 
Join our amazing community in our [url=https://discord.gg/survivalnationvr]Discord[/url]

✍️Please do not hesitate to share your first impressions and leave an honest review

[hr][/hr]
[h3]🧟‍♂️ Survive the Zombie Apocalypse[/h3]
The zombie apocalypse happened. What caused it? Who's behind the plague? How do you contract it? All of these trivial questions have gone with the first bite, turning humans from Earth's apex predator to the new predators' most delicious prey. Join the Survival Nation, fight zombies, and keep what remains of the human civilization alive!

[h3]🔨 Develop Unique Skills[/h3]
Each survivor is precious, potentially developing a unique set of skills and abilities. All of which may be of use to your group of survivors, spread across three distinct skill trees: Combat, Survival, and Endurance. Each also has needs that need to be met. Harness their potential and survive in a collapsed world: Scour derelict buildings for canned goods, hunt animals and fish, or try and keep your camp intact long enough to harvest fresh produce from the garden.

[h3]⛺ A Tailored Experience[/h3]
If you prefer online play and multiplayer, Survival Nation: Lost Horizon has you covered. Adventure across the post-apocalypse in groups and face challenges together in PVE. Prefer solitary pursuits without the threat of other players hanging over you? Set up your own server, where you can explore the open world and experience Survival Nation: Lost Horizon at your own pace!

notes.title: Dev Update #3
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!🧟

A lot has happened since our last dev update. As you may have seen, we participated in the Steam Next Fest. During this festival, you could play our demo. Thank you very much to all those who played it and left feedback!
We also changed our name - you can read more about it here.
What about game development?
[h2]Day-Night Cycle[/h2]

Our team has worked on the Day-Night Cycle. Apart from visual effects, we also adjusted the enemies. During the night they are stronger and more aggressive. A moon icon appears above the enemies' heads, this way we know that we are dealing with night zombies.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_75b88ab207a748e3b7b9e3822da80185~mv2.gif[/img]

[h2]Cooking[/h2]

When the player approaches the bonfire, the UI will appear, where the player will have the option of cooking “prepare food” or fast traveling “travel”. After selecting “prepare food”, all the food we can bake and we have in our inventory will appear. Then the player just has to select one of them and click "cook". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/57c124c12a6c36e16f15a3d06768d788706b9194.png[/img]
[h2]Character Customization[/h2]

Express yourself in the game! We added the Character Customization Panel to the main menu. The player can choose skin and hair color, hairstyle and add moustache or/and beard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/3c5e3949847f0fa54e0feb68468bfdf43e84c4e6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/39750467dd08656d9486f61267b739452f53fc1e.png[/img]

In the time since the last dev update, we have also been working on the demo version at Steam Next Fest and on the general optimization of the game. We have also started working on the Steam Deck version.
We encourage you to join our community on  [url=discord.gg/6wtje2UW6P] Discord [/url]!

Add Survival Nation GO to your wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504380/Survival_Nation_Lost_Horizon/

notes.title: We're changing our name...
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Survivors! [/b] 🧟

We wanted to drop in with some more official news - the name of the game is changing.

The reasoning behind the name change is fairly simple. We wanted the name of the game to be more aligned with what a player's experience will be while they play it. The "GO" title has become associated with mobile games over the last few years and we felt that was not quite the right fit despite our goal of ensuring the game will be playable on the go with a SteamDeck.

After some internal discussion, we decided to go with [b]Survival Nation: Lost Horizon[/b] as our new game name. Since the game is a top-down experience, you will never see the horizon. 😉

With the name change comes a few other updates such as brand new logo and new social links. All of our socials have been updated with the new name so to find us, please use the links below!

Thank you everyone for your continued support and all your feedback.

notes.title: Second Dev Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Survivors! [/b] 🧟

Welcome to our Second Dev Update! This time, we want to show you what we have been working on since our last post. 

[h2]Bow[/h2]
Our developers succeeded in adding a bow mechanic. Now, the players can freely use the bow and hunt the animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/344042ef9d16d79cb1777fe11c67740701c1f390.jpg[/img]
[h2]Headshots[/h2]
Now, when shooting with guns, you may get additional damage points when headshooting a zombie. To do that, you need to aim with your shooting indicator at the zombie’s chest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/1dd6b290dc56206284d8e888bee2e33427d6a962.jpg[/img]
[h2]Fast travel[/h2] 
The player will be able to craft a bonfire, take it from the inventory and place it somewhere on the map, enabling fast travel to the Camps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/f06d86312acae605a0756c06f30d6959a13537ac.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other cosmetic addition[/h3]
[list][*]added a direction indicator when following a quest 
[*]pin pad mechanics for Turn the Radio quest 
[*]fixed some of the roofs [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/e42f7bbba978739d55486710d06e23fb09883def.png[/img]

Implementing a [b]PVP mode[/b] into the game was a very challenging but important part of our work. It is still difficult to confirm, but we are considering increasing the player cap in the server, however, this feature would require a lot of work and time, so it remains under consultation. 

Be a part of our community and join our [url=discord.gg/6wtje2UW6P] Discord [/url]!

Add Survival Nation GO to your wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504380/Survival_Nation_GO/

notes.title: Game Development Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Survivors! [/b] 🧟

We are so excited to have all of you here.
While we wait for [b]Survival Nation GO[/b] release, we'll share development footage with you to show you what we're currently working on, and what's new and to show you the game development progress.

[h2]Pre-alpha gameplay [/h2]
There is a pre-alpha gameplay,  for those of you who didn’t see it.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7zg8lzWdQlU 
We recently finished our work on the game's demo. We've been busy adapting quests to non-VR version. Some things required adjustments, especially those that we could grab/touch in VR. 

[h2]Fishing and Metal Detector[/h2]
Our team also has been working on fishing and using a metal detector for the PC version. 
While fishing, there will be a mini-game based on keeping the bar below the fish icon. If the bar is under the fish, the progress bar fills up. If it's not under the fish, the progress bar goes back. When the progress bar is full, the fish is caught.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/47fcabf08b80777352e883f79869019ab0c4bac0.jpg[/img]
The metal detector will work similarly to the VR version, except that its screen will be displayed in the lower right corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/181859a3b39b3e30f826690f2dc08fed4b26a1c2.png[/img]
[h1]Main Menu and Item Wheel [/h1]
We also worked on improving graphics and animations, adjusting UI, and many other things.
Here is the preview of the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/3bae55d821808c4ce358b6e3684bbc6feeefc637.jpg[/img]
And the item wheel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/93eb5a757a61633c592399a6c42d76f1401db9ca.jpg[/img]
We added better visibility of items. When we are close to an item, it highlights on white, when we move the mouse over it, it turns blue and the name of the item appears.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391034/32bef4df57de548b8d9ece4949588c245547b718.jpg[/img]
